objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five pull_request/push workflows received deliberate decisions (deploy, docs-site, tests changed; nightly-sweep and triage correctly left as non-PR/push), and the required check tests.yml got exactly the one valid shape — a single workflow with no workflow-level path filter that computes salience internally and gates the real steps with `if:`, no companion skip workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each filter lists paths plausibly tied to that workflow's own work (deploy: src/deploy.sh/manifests, docs-site: docs/mkdocs.yml, tests: src/test/lockfile/self), and each includes its own workflow file rather than copying a sibling's list, though the actual step consumption can't be fully verified from the diff.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: Left the schedule-only and issue-driven workflows and the ruleset untouched and edited no unrelated files, but added `workflow_dispatch` to tests.yml — a trigger change outside the path-filter audit, transparently flagged but still scope beyond what was asked.
